definitions.relevant: chunk source matches a labeled source file AND the chunk text/section mentions a labeled command (whole word)
definitions.recall@k: fraction of questions with >= 1 relevant chunk among the top k (hit rate)
definitions.mrr@10: mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant chunk in the top 10 (0 when none)
definitions.command_hit@6: secondary: fraction of questions whose top 6 contain a chunk from ANY source (documentation, example or flow script) naming a labeled command

note: The questions were written before any retrieval result was seen. There is no separate development set: the same 40 questions were used to check three design changes (Porter stemming in BM25, per-ranker source+section deduplication before fusion, tool names in README titles), so the numbers are slightly optimistic. Relevance counts only the labeled primary documentation; usage examples are credited by command_hit@6 only.
